welcome:
Welcome to the Argo CD CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated GitOps environment.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, log in to the Argo CD server.
Create a new application from a Git repository.
steps.expect: argocd app create payments-api --repo https://github.com/acme/k8s-manifests.git --path services/payments-api --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace production
steps.hint: Try: argocd app create payments-api --repo https://github.com/acme/k8s-manifests.git --path services/payments-api --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace production

steps.instruction: List all applications to confirm it was created.
Check the application details and sync status.
View what would change if you sync (dry-run diff).
Sync the application to deploy the latest manifests from Git.
Wait for the application to become healthy after sync.
Verify the application is now Synced and Healthy.
Check the current status of the web-frontend app — it's showing Degraded.
View the deployment history to see previous revisions.
Compare the current (broken) revision 5 against the last known-good revision 4.
Rollback to revision 4 (the last healthy release).
Wait for the rollback to complete and pods to stabilise.
Verify the app is back to Healthy status.
Check the updated history to confirm rollback is recorded.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  argocd login                   — Authenticate to Argo CD server
  argocd app list                — List all applications
  argocd app get [app]           — Show application details
  argocd app create              — Create a new application
  argocd app sync [app]          — Sync application to target state
  argocd app diff [app]          — Show diff between live and desired state
  argocd app history [app]       — Show deployment history
  argocd app rollback [app] [rev]— Rollback to a previous revision
  argocd app delete [app]        — Delete an application
  argocd app set [app]           — Update application parameters
  argocd app wait [app]          — Wait for app to reach healthy state
  argocd app terminate-op [app]  — Terminate running operation
  argocd app actions list [app]  — List available resource actions
  argocd repo list               — List configured repositories
  argocd repo add                — Add a Git repository
  argocd proj list               — List projects
  argocd proj get [proj]         — Show project details
  argocd proj create             — Create a new project
  argocd cluster list            — List registered clusters
  argocd cluster add             — Add a cluster
  argocd account list            — List accounts
  argocd account get-user-info   — Show current user info
  argocd version                 — Show version info

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help
